lyrics.ti:
[[chorus]]
ኪዳነ ምሕረት ንኤርትራ
ለምንልና ምሕረት ክትረክብ ቅሳነት
ኣድሕንያ ካብ ዓለም መዓት
[[/chorus]]

ቃልኪዳን ዘለኪ ኪዳነ ምሕረት
ናይ ዘልዓለም [[highlight]]ኪዳነ ምሕረት[[/highlight]]
መመክሒት ኢኺ [[highlight]]ኪዳነ ምሕረት[[/highlight]]
ንፍጥረታት ዓለም [[highlight]]ኪዳነ ምሕረት[[/highlight]]

ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን ኪዳነ ምሕረት
ትንቢት ናይ ነቢያት [[highlight]]ኪዳነ ምሕረት[[/highlight]]
ናይ ሓዋርያት ሞገስ [[highlight]]ምሕረት[[/highlight]]
ኣደ ናይ ሰማእታት [[highlight]]ኪዳነ ምሕረት[[/highlight]]

ኤፍሬም ብውዳሴ ኪዳነ ምሕረት
ንዘመስገነኪ [[highlight]]ምሕረት[[/highlight]]
ደመና ናይ ኤልያስ [[highlight]]ምሕረት[[/highlight]]
ድንግል ንስኺ ኢኺ [[highlight]]ኪዳነ ምሕረት[[/highlight]]

መድኃኒት ምስ መጸ ኪዳነ ምሕረት
ሰይጣን’ውን ሓፈረ [[highlight]]ኪዳነ ምሕረት[[/highlight]]
ናይቲ ዜና ኣብሳሪ [[highlight]]ኪዳነ ምሕረት[[/highlight]]
ገብርኤል ነበረ [[highlight]]ኪዳነ ምሕረት[[/highlight]]

ናይ በሓቂ መልኣኽ ኪዳነ ምሕረት
ምኻኑ ርኢኺ [[highlight]]ኪዳነ ምሕረት[[/highlight]]
ይኹነለይ ኢልኪ [[highlight]]ኪዳነ ምሕረት[[/highlight]]
ቃሉ ተቐቢልኪ [[highlight]]ኪዳነ ምሕረት[[/highlight]]

ብጽንዓት ክሓልፎ ኪዳነ ምሕረት
ቲ’ናይ ለይቲ ግርማ [[highlight]]ኪዳነ ምሕረት[[/highlight]]
ምእንታን ክንኣቱ [[highlight]]ኪዳነ ምሕረት[[/highlight]]
ኣብ ጻድቃን ከተማ [[highlight]]ኪዳነ ምሕረት[[/highlight]]

ክንለብስ ፍቕርኺ ኪዳነ ምሕረት
ከም ሓዋርያት [[highlight]]ምሕረት[[/highlight]]
ከማኺ ትሕትና [[highlight]]ምሕረት[[/highlight]]
ጽንዓት ከም ሰማእታት [[highlight]]ምሕረት[[/highlight]]
lyrics.ti_ro:
[[chorus]]
Kidane mihret niʾertira
Lemnilna mihret kitrekb qisanet
ʾAdhinya kab ʿalem meʿat
[[/chorus]]

Qalkidan zeleki Kidane mihret
Nay zelʿalem [[highlight]]Kidane mihret[[/highlight]]
Memekhit ʾikhi [[highlight]]Kidane mihret[[/highlight]]
Nift'iretat ʿalem [[highlight]]Kidane mihret[[/highlight]]

Qidsite qidusan Kidane mihret
Tinbit nay nebiyat [[highlight]]Kidane mihret[[/highlight]]
Nay hawaryat moges [[highlight]]mihret[[/highlight]]
ʾAde nay semaʾitat [[highlight]]Kidane mihret[[/highlight]]

ʾEfrem biwdase Kidane mihret
Nizemesgeneki [[highlight]]mihret[[/highlight]]
Demena nay ʾElyas [[highlight]]mihret[[/highlight]]
Dingil niskhi ʾikhi [[highlight]]Kidane mihret[[/highlight]]

Medhanit mis metse Kidane mihret
Seyt'an’win hafere [[highlight]]Kidane mihret[[/highlight]]
Nayti zena ʾabsari [[highlight]]Kidane mihret[[/highlight]]
Gebriʾel nebere [[highlight]]Kidane mihret[[/highlight]]

Nay behaqi melʾakh Kidane mihret
Mikhanu riʾikhi [[highlight]]Kidane mihret[[/highlight]]
Yikhuneley ʾilki [[highlight]]Kidane mihret[[/highlight]]
Qalu teqhebilki [[highlight]]Kidane mihret[[/highlight]]

Bitsniʿat kihalfo Kidane mihret
Ti’nay leyti girma [[highlight]]Kidane mihret[[/highlight]]
Miʾintan kinʾatu [[highlight]]Kidane mihret[[/highlight]]
ʾAb tsadqan ketema [[highlight]]Kidane mihret[[/highlight]]

Kinlebs fiqhrikhi Kidane mihret
Kem hawaryat [[highlight]]mihret[[/highlight]]
Kemakhi tihtina [[highlight]]mihret[[/highlight]]
Tsinʿat kem semaʾitat [[highlight]]mihret[[/highlight]]
